Shackleton's Forgotten Men

by Lennard Bickel

The Untold Tale of an Antarctic Tragedy

Format:

Paperback

Buy the book from:

...

When Ernest Shackleton resolved to cross Antarctica in 1915, he knew the task would require two parties of men. Shackleton and his crew aimed to cross the continent - but were to meet with disaster when their ship, the Endurance , was frozen into the ice of the Weddell Sea.

...

Their mission was to haul sledges almost 2,000 miles across the harsh interior in order to set up a lifeline of depots for the coming Shackleton party. However, like the men of the Endurance , this group also lost their ship, the Aurora - along with their supplies - when a ferocious polar gale ripped it from its moorings.

...

Scurvy and madness overtook several men and, in the end, three of the party died - but not before they had accomplished their task.
This is the story of ordinary men who rose to extraordinary heights of courage, determination and endurance. While their achievement was futile - Shackleton never came - it was also one of the greatest and most astonishing in the heroic age of polar exploration.
